exchange_family_policy.family_collapse: median home implied probability within family
exchange_family_policy.sharp_consensus: median home implied probability across available exchange families

information_clock: odds_snapshots.capture_time; poll observed_at is maximum capture_time across exchange rows in collector_run_id
movement_policy: Window movement uses only polls actually observed inside the window. Zero polls => missing. One poll => level available but movement missing. No stale poll is carried into a window.

price_representation.consensus_interpretation: median consensus of available exchange-family back-odds-derived home probabilities; not an exchange back/lay midpoint
price_representation.probability_source: overround-adjusted implied probabilities derived from exchange h2h back odds

windows.all_pregame: all observed exchange polls before T0
